## Discriminatory strategies {.smaller}

<br>

**Parity (P):** Equal division between ingroup and outgroup member

**Maximum joint profit (MJP):** Giving away as many points to the others in total


::: {.fragment}
<br>
**Maximum ingroup profit (MIP):** Giving as many points as possible to ingroup members in absolute terms

**Maximum differentiation (MD) or “winning”:** Difference between ingroup and outgroup members as large as possible
:::

::: {.fragment}
<br>
**Favouritism (FAV):** Combination of MD and MIP
:::
